---
title: "descriptive_stats"
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-11-19"
---

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(data.table)   # fread
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)          # datatable output
library(scales)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(plotly)

# Paths to CSVs (adjust if needed)

md_csv = "predictions.csv"
metadata <- fread(md_csv)
metadata = metadata[IS_VALID == TRUE]
ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "test"], aes(BF_cbrMG_MM, BF_PRED, shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + geom_point()

metadata[, DRYMASS_MG_PRED := (BF_PRED*ROI_SIZE_MM)^3 ]
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG := DRYMASS_MG^ (1/3)]
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED := DRYMASS_MG_PRED^ (1/3)]
metadata[, sqrtAREA := (TRANSPARENT_PIXELS / DPI )^(1/2)]
ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "train"], aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED, shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + geom_point() 
ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "test"], aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED, shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + geom_point() 



mod <- lm(cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED ~ cbrDRYMASS_MG, metadata[SPLIT == "test"])
summary(mod)
```
The area based model:
```{r}
metadata[SPLIT == "train"]
ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "train" ], aes( cbrDRYMASS_MG, sqrtAREA, shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + geom_point()

area_model <- lm(cbrDRYMASS_MG ~ sqrtAREA, metadata[SPLIT == "train"])
summary(area_model)
metadata[, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM := predict(area_model, metadata)]
ggplot(metadata[SPLIT == "test"], aes(cbrDRYMASS_MG, cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM, shape=DATASET, colour=DATASET)) + geom_point() 

mod <- lm(cbrDRYMASS_MG_PRED_AREA_LM ~ cbrDRYMASS_MG, metadata[SPLIT == "test"])
summary(mod)
```
